collection.title: Peugeot Partner 1997 to 2008 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Peugeot Partner 1997 to 2008 requires a 22" wiper blade the drivers side and a 21" on the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. . We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Partner which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
